FX-BILAT-001.says: Bilateral Blur as it starts, Radius 5, Threshold 20, Colorize on: the grain, 8 levels either side of the skin, is smoothed toward the skin, while the line and the dark specks, far more than 20 from the skin, stay as they are to well within a level; the white speck, 41 and 65 from the skin in green and blue, stays far lighter than the skin. The hole stays a hole and the half-covered column keeps its half covering.

FX-BILAT-003.says: Threshold 0: each pixel counts only itself, so the drawing is unchanged.

FX-BILAT-004.says: Colorize off: the same smoothing worked on luminance alone, and every pixel that shows is grey, red, green and blue equal; the line stays dark and the outline is kept.

FX-BILAT-005.says: Colorize off with Radius 0: no smoothing, each pixel only its own luminance, grey.

FX-BILAT-006.says: Threshold 255: likeness hardly matters, a soft blur that stays inside the drawing: the line and the specks are blurred into the skin, and the hole, the empty column and the empty row stay empty.

FX-BILAT-007.says: Radius 1.5, a disc of nine: a lighter smoothing of the grain than FX-BILAT-001.

FX-BILAT-008.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing and frame 2 is FX-BILAT-001.

FX-BILAT-009.says: Threshold keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing and frame 2 is FX-BILAT-001.

FX-BILAT-010.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 50 at frame 4, eased past its end (about 64 at frame 2): frame 2 is held at 50, the same as frame 4.

FX-BILAT-011.says: Bilateral Blur as it starts, the layer moved three pixels right: FX-BILAT-001 moved with it.

FX-BILAT-012.says: Bilateral Blur, Radius 51, above 50. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BILAT-013.says: Bilateral Blur, Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BILAT-014.says: Bilateral Blur, Threshold 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BILAT-015.says: Bilateral Blur, Threshold -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BILAT-016.says: Bilateral Blur, Threshold keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BILAT-017.says: Bilateral Blur, Colorize "sometimes", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
